scenes.caption: Ariadne gives Theseus a sword and a spool of thread. She tells him to fasten one end at the entrance, and unwind the rest as he walks. He can fight the monster if he chooses. But the thread is his only sure way through the maze.

scenes.caption: Ariadne leaves her father and her home to flee with Theseus. Their ship cuts through the Aegean. She has risked everything for him. At night on deck, the island of Crete disappears behind them, and she finally lets herself believe they have a future.
